facts.statement: The genus Orkoraptor was described by Novas, Ezcurra, and Lecuona in 2008.
Orkoraptor lived during the late Cretaceous Period in Argentina.
facts.quote: from the late Cretaceous Period of Argentina

facts.statement: The name Orkoraptor means "Toothed River thief".
facts.quote: The name Orkoraptor means "Toothed River thief"

facts.statement: The name is derived from the Aoniken word "Orr-Korr", the local name for the La Leona River.
facts.quote: derived from the Aoniken "Orr-Korr", the local name for the La Leona River

facts.statement: Orkoraptor was a medium-sized theropod measuring 8.4 meters long and weighing 1400 kilograms.
facts.quote: Orkoraptor was a medium-sized theropod, measuring 8.4 m long and weighing 1400 kg

facts.statement: The holotype specimen, MPM-Pv 3457, was excavated in 2001.
facts.quote: The holotype, MPM-Pv 3457 was excavated in 2001

facts.statement: Orkoraptor possessed specialized teeth that were unserrated on the front side and had an 8-shaped cross section.
facts.quote: specialized teeth which are unserrated on the mesial (front) side and have an 8-shaped cross section

facts.statement: Original describers could not conclusively assign Orkoraptor to a specific family because many features contradicted those of coelurosaurs.
facts.quote: However, many other features contradict those of these families and other coelurosaurs, so its original describers were unable to conclusively assign it to any specific family

facts.statement: Subsequent studies recovered Orkoraptor within the clade Megaraptora.
facts.quote: Orkoraptor was subsequently recovered in Megaraptora

facts.statement: Orkoraptor was originally thought to be from the Maastrichtian, but is now considered to date from the Cenomanian to Santonian.
facts.quote: It was originally identified as coming from the Maastrichtian, and thus the youngest known megaraptoran, but more recently is considered to be from the Cenomanian to Santonian

facts.statement: Orkoraptor lived approximately between 76 and 70 million years ago, during the Campanian to Maastrichtian epochs.
facts.quote: hace aproximadamente entre 76 y 70 millones de años, durante las épocas del Campaniense al Maastrichtiense

facts.statement: Found in southern Patagonia, Argentina, Orkoraptor is one of the most southerly known carnivorous dinosaurs in South America.
facts.quote: Al haber sido hallado en la Formación de Pari Aike del sur de Patagonia Argentina, es uno de los dinosaurios carnívoros más meridionales de Sudamérica

facts.statement: Phylogenetic trees from the Gualicho shinyae publication suggest megaraptorans are either allosauroids or basal coelurosaurs.
facts.quote: Los árboles filogenéticos en la publicación de Gualicho shinyae han descubierto que los megarraptoranos son alosauroides o celurosaurios basales

facts.statement: In a 2009 study, Benson, Carrano, and Brusatte classified Orkoraptor as an allosauroid within the family Neovenatoridae.
facts.quote: En una investigación realizada en 2009 por Benson, Carrano y Brusatte, incluyeron a Orkoraptor como un alosauroide dentro de la familia Neovenatoridae

facts.statement: The time range for Orkoraptor is estimated from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

rejected.quote: It is known from incomplete fossil remains including parts of the skull, teeth, tail vertebrae, and a partial tibia
